# Tokeness Docs

> Tokeness is an AI API gateway. Use one API key to call multiple AI models through an OpenAI-compatible interface. Manage API keys, quota, balance, and usage logs from the Tokeness console.
>
> Base URL: https://n.tokeness.dev/v1
> Console: https://tokeness.ai
> Docs: https://docs.tokeness.ai
>
> Generated from scripts/llms-manifest.mjs. Do not edit this file directly.

## Core Facts

- [About Tokeness](https://docs.tokeness.ai/about): Canonical product facts, API endpoint, billing model, supported integration types, and official links.
- [FAQ](https://docs.tokeness.ai/faq): Tokeness FAQ covering Base URL, auth errors, balance, model names, billing, Claude Code, and supported tools.
- [Models and Billing](https://docs.tokeness.ai/billing/pricing): Prepaid billing model, usage logs, model price policy, and cost control guidance.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://docs.tokeness.ai/guide/getting-started): Minimum onboarding flow: sign in, top up, create API key, copy model name, and make a test call.
- [API Keys](https://docs.tokeness.ai/guide/api-keys): API key management, project separation, quota control, and safe key handling.
- [Dashboard Overview](https://docs.tokeness.ai/guide/dashboard): Console pages for overview, usage logs, wallet, and troubleshooting.

## Integration Guides
